title: Data graphs: pie charts and line graphs
subject: math

items.prompt: Two line graphs show sales rising. Graph A looks much steeper than graph B, but graph A has an axis of 0 to 50 and graph B has an axis of 0 to 200, and both sales rose by 20. Which graph had the bigger increase?
choices: Graph A, because its line is steeper
Graph B, because its axis goes up to 200
items.misconceptionCode: A steeper line always means a bigger increase.

items.prompt: In the pie chart of 12 pupils, 6 chose apples, 3 chose bananas and 3 chose grapes. What fraction of the class chose bananas?
A line graph shows plants sold: Jan 20, Feb 35, Mar 30, Apr 50. In which month did sales dip, and how many plants were sold in April?
items.answer: Sales dipped in March; 50 plants were sold in April.

items.prompt: In the pie chart, 3 of 12 pupils chose grapes. What fraction of the class chose grapes?
What fraction of the pie chart is taken by apples, if 6 of the 12 pupils chose apples?
Soccer got 13 votes and badminton got 8 votes. How many more votes did soccer get? Show the working.
